  function detectLang(){
    var probe = document.querySelector("#network .section-title");
    var text = probe ? (probe.textContent || "") : "";
    if(/幅広い|サービス提供先|ネットワーク/.test(text)) return "ja";
    if(/廣泛|曾服務|網絡/.test(text)) return "zh";
    var htmlLang = (document.documentElement.getAttribute("lang") || "").toLowerCase();
    if(htmlLang.indexOf("ja") === 0) return "ja";
    if(htmlLang.indexOf("zh") === 0) return "zh";
    return "en";
  }
